regime: Broad relief rally: stocks, metals and miners rebound sharply and volatility drops, while yields and the dollar firm on Fed hike bets
takeaway: Stocks had their biggest day since April 2025 after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO: the Nasdaq rose 6.5% and the VIX fell about 26%. Gold rose about 2.8% and silver about 4.7%, and gold miners gained more than gold, but gold is still about 9% below a month ago, so the short-term downtrend check still applies. The 2-year yield and the dollar rose as traders kept pricing a December Fed hike, which matches the Fed-hike pattern.
